name: Courtesan’s Allure
body:
Aura faint enchantment; CL 3rd; Slot —; Price 2,000 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

About Magic Perfumes Magic perfumes act as other perfumes. They last for 4 hours and make it easier for creatures with scent to notice or track you. Their effects operate in an aura of 10 ft. (or 5 ft. outdoors) centered on you. Detect magic reveals the aura.

This perfume benefits bards and other individuals who rely on the attention of other creatures. Courtesan’s allure adds a +2 bonus to the DC of any mind-affecting compulsion effect or spell originating from you, such as a bard’s fascinate ability.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft (alchemy), Craft Wondrous Item; Spells eagle’s splendor; Cost 1,000 gp
